scoreMeaning: Evidence-informed FinFindr seasonal pier opportunity under supportive temperature, using the unchanged core 1-10 rubric; not a measured catch probability or agency score.
method: Explicit sparse anchors are calibration judgments. Monthly creel supports broad timing and within-species comparisons, not precise dates or universal between-species catch-rate conversion. Continuous linear interpolation only inside each listed segment. No extrapolation, annual wrap, gap filling or implicit zero.
dateBoundaryMeaning: Month boundaries and representative mid-month anchors are declared review conventions, not observed arrival/departure dates. Mid-month peaks have approximately month-level timing resolution. Exact report dates identify evidence, not measured optimum days.
winterTreatment: January-March lack matched local creel support for these species; absence of surveys or reports cannot justify a floor score. Other months remain null outside justified proposals. Core four-species winter configuration is unchanged.
validationStatus: Research proposals only; magnitude and covered-side uncertainty retained. Phase 2 must resolve eligibility, representative thermal response and bounded availability before runtime integration. Phase 3 must verify the annual lineup; no claim of high-confidence annual numerical completion.
